changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as the paper doesn't actually perform summarization tasks. Removed 'TWO-SIDES' duplicate and kept 'TWOSIDES'. Removed GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4 as they are only mentioned in evaluation context, not as generation models. Simplified outputs to focus on the core NLG task.
Normalized F1-Score variants to base form. The paper uses F1-Score (macro) for DrugBank and PR-AUC for TWOSIDES as primary metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4 are only evaluated as baseline models, not as evaluators.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely automatic using the mentioned metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on generating prompts/text selections for drug-drug interaction prediction, not traditional NLG tasks. The NLG component is part of a larger drug prediction system. The extraction was mostly accurate but included some irrelevant items (GPT models as generators when they were actually baselines) and redundant dataset names.
